translated_text: My love, In Paris on the 13th. V.40 These somewhat difficult and emotional days, in letters, which now arrive regularly (who knows until when) are such a comfort, such a relief for me. Only I wonder now if you are still where you are, and if you will be for a long time. Partly on oþù Fryz vens .. better not to more перал Ничеча d' It is worth a lot, they do that, I try "I think as little as possible but I will only really be happy the day you are near me again.... I don't know if I have already told you that your photograph gives me immense pleasure. It's not a "Fre good" photo, but I like it eminently!! It's so you - I see you - you as I love you - I carry it in my bag and I look at it from time to time In time after. It's always a little better – I'd like the other part, ни that воно fu send me 2 or 3 9x12 proofs (bous lirages) of the photo where we are both, bu peux. Ask the Censor if sending them will ensure they arrive safely. I'm sending you the original Illford invoice enclosed. He he, don't send any more - t'cu. But keep the money there, I have some for now and I hope the State, majo, will pay us in turn one day. I'm not there yet. But still because you wrote to me that Spira won't be there before the 15th. Tomorrow, asce on without Spira, I'll go if possible. If he cashes the money. I would only say Spira could have done what was necessary before leaving. Hla is not venne because his brother-in-law, the doctor, arrived on leave (he's lucky) and has 2 months. I'm going to Montparnasse for coffee - Res amores Renard out a huge amount of trouble, Dagny is selling me 2 suits and a coat and 2 pairs of shoes and a bag, and they have a huge amount of difficulty finding exactly what they're looking for. I told them yesterday next leave (when, my God??) I need the apartment because I want to set up Thomas's room (!?) in the office. They were surprised and they declared "slost all our plans" / "He" because they thought they would return to the apartment. Alons, I said I was extremely sorry but that I needed a room now. Budi wants me to wait until the move-in date in September because of the holidays in July. Bubi wants to live alone there and only get an apartment in the fall, but I absolutely want it done when I'm there, because if I leave for one season or another, I'll be alone with all this work and I'll never get out. Anyway, we'll see. Mom received a lovely letter from Freud this morning, asking her to go to Tarade. But if Piste, I don't see any sign of her going. There are alerts everywhere right now, she'll be terribly worried there. Here at least we're together. Here the world can stay. Besides, Liebling fusus c'nt everything for today, ceris me, known these days regularly. I know well what it means to receive letters every day and I am entirely at your service. Love you, Babo.
